claims.content: To view daily sales performance metrics including total lots sold, average selling price, sell-through rate, and gross revenue.

goal.raw_text: To view daily sales performance metrics including total lots sold, average selling price, sell-through rate, and gross revenue.

claims.content: The Business Owner must be logged into the Auction Administration application.
The system must have recorded auction data, including completed auctions and associated sales transactions.
The 'Sales Report' capability must be enabled in the user's profile or permissions settings.
The Business Owner logs into the Auction Administration application and navigates to the Sales Report section.

trigger.raw_text: The Business Owner logs into the Auction Administration application and navigates to the Sales Report section.

claims.content: The Business Owner navigates to the 'Sales Report' section within the Auction Administration application.
The system displays the 'Current Auction Status Page' in 'Daily View' mode by default.
The Business Owner reviews the summary statistics at the top of the page, including Total Lots Sold, Average Selling Price, Sell-Through Rate, and Gross Revenue.
The Business Owner scans the detailed table rows to analyze performance metrics for specific product categories or individual items sold during the day.
If necessary, the Business Owner uses the 'Switch to Hourly View' button to toggle the display granularity from daily totals to hourly breakdowns.
The Business Owner clicks the 'Switch to Hourly View' button (Step 4 of Main Flow) to toggle the display granularity from daily totals to hourly breakdowns.
The Business Owner selects a specific time period other than the default 'Today' view by using the date selector controls located at the top of the report page.
The Business Owner has successfully reviewed the daily sales performance metrics, including Total Lots Sold, Average Selling Price, Sell-Through Rate, and Gross Revenue.
The system has displayed the detailed table of sales data for the selected time period (defaulting to 'Today'), showing metrics for each product category or item sold.
If requested by the Business Owner, the system has toggled the view granularity from 'Daily' to 'Hourly', displaying a breakdown of sales performance by hour.
The Business Owner has analyzed the sales data to identify trends, top-performing categories, or areas requiring attention based on the presented metrics.
